$comment: The wallets this demo stack knows about. DEV ONLY.
Every seed below is PUBLIC: the first three are the well-known Midnight CFG_PRESET=dev
genesis seeds, `lace-test` is the seed Lace uses for its own testing, and the rest are
placeholders invented for this repository. They control value only on a throwaway local
`undeployed` chain. NEVER reuse any of them anywhere else, and never fund one with real
value on any network.
Two wallet facades built on ONE seed, connected to ONE node, FORCE EACH OTHER'S
CONNECTION DOWN. The second to connect wins and the first silently stops syncing. There
is no error naming the cause: it presents as 'the batcher stopped submitting' or 'the
solver went quiet', hours later, and looks like a node or network fault.
That is why the batcher, the solver, the e2e maker and the e2e taker are FOUR DIFFERENT
seeds here, and why the solver's is dedicated rather than borrowed from the genesis set.
Adding a new long-lived wallet facade to this stack means adding a new seed to this file,
never reusing one that is already assigned a role.

addressStability: Addresses depend only on the seed and the network id — not on chain state — so they
stay valid across a `./down.sh -v` reset and across a redeploy.
CROSS-CHECKED: the four seeds this roster shares with midnight-2-offers (genesis-1,
genesis-2, genesis-3, lace-test) derive BYTE-IDENTICAL unshielded, shielded, dust and
userAddress values under the 1.x toolkit here and under the 2.x toolkit there. So the
address encoding is stable across the two version lines, and these values were really
derived on 1.x rather than copied across.
genesisFundingIsUNVERIFIED: `expect` is null on every wallet ON PURPOSE. The 2.x sibling records concrete genesis
balances (5 UTXOs, 250,000,000,000,000 stars, DUST registered at genesis) measured
against node 2.0.0-rc.4. Those are facts about THAT node's dev preset, and copying them
here would assert something about midnight-node 1.0.0 that nobody has measured.
P1/T1.1 brings up node 1.0.0 with CFG_PRESET=dev and verifies which of these wallets it
actually funds and whether DUST is registered at genesis; the measured values are filled
in then, and scripts/verify-wallets.sh starts asserting them. Until then `funding` says
'genesis-unverified' rather than 'genesis' — an unmeasured claim is worse than none.

wallets.name: genesis-1
wallets.role: faucet / funding source — the seed MIDNIGHT_GENESIS_SEED points at

wallets.name: genesis-2
wallets.role: spare prefunded actor — a second demo party, deliberately unassigned

wallets.name: batcher
wallets.role: THE OFFER-FILES BATCHER wallet — signs and submits gasless batches
$comment: Genesis seed 3, matching the proven 1.x deploy prototype (00005-D1/E1). It is a
long-lived facade: the batcher holds this wallet open for the whole life of the
stack. Nothing else may use this seed — see the facade hazard at the top of this
file. The 2.x sibling assigns the batcher role to genesis-2 instead; the two
repositories differ here on purpose and neither should be 'corrected' to match.

wallets.name: lace-test
wallets.role: THE wallet to import into Lace — Midnight's own canonical test wallet
$comment: Reachable from three directions that all agree:
* midnight-node's Earthfile genesis-seeds block lists this 64-byte seed as
'wallet-seed-3' with the comment 'wallet-seed-3 is the wallet Lace uses for
testing';
* @midnight-ntwrk/testkit-js defines TEST_MNEMONIC as exactly the mnemonic below
(23x 'abandon' + 'diesel');
* the BIP-39 master seed of that mnemonic (empty passphrase) IS this seed, byte for
byte — which is why it is 64 bytes rather than 32.
Whether midnight-node 1.0.0's dev preset funds it is a P1 measurement, not an
assumption: see $verification.genesisFundingIsUNVERIFIED.
wallets.mnemonic: abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon diesel

wallets.name: solver
wallets.role: THE COW SOLVER's wallet — holds swap-token inventory and settles relay intents
$comment: A DEDICATED, NON-GENESIS seed. Two things make this non-negotiable:
1. The facade hazard at the top of this file. The solver holds a wallet open for the
whole life of the stack, exactly like the batcher does. Sharing a seed between
them would silently kill one of the two connections, and the symptom — an empty
ladder, or batches that stop landing — points nowhere near the cause.
2. It is NOT funded at genesis, and must not be. The pinned PR #52 solver publishes
NOTHING for a pair it holds no tokenIn inventory for, so its balance is a
deliberate, observable input to the demo: the `solver-provision` one-shot funds
it with both dev tokens through the kernel's own bootstrap, and fails loudly if
it cannot. A silently unfunded solver yields an empty ladder with no error, which
is the worst failure this stack has.

wallets.name: e2e-maker
wallets.role: the canonical e2e driver's MAKER — posts the signed zswap offer to POST /v1/offers

wallets.name: e2e-taker
wallets.role: the canonical e2e driver's TAKER — submits the intent at the relay and is credited
wallets.$comment: Its credit is asserted for EXACT EQUALITY with the demanded amount, not a bound, so this wallet must start empty of the demanded token and be used by nothing else.
